assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / architecture concept redesign. Asset: BYZANTINE HEADQUARTERS AGE THREE, evolved from Image 1. Image 1 defines exact square ground plot, positions, Byzantine identity, normal door/window human scale and three cameras. Image 2 is old warm material and GRANDEUR inspiration only. Image 3 is age two, ONLY anchors common world scale, human-size windows/doors, 5 by 5 ground footprint, warm palette. Make age THREE visibly more magnificent and more developed than age two by adding ARCHITECTURAL HEIGHT AND STOREYS, not by scaling the existing building up: a central commanding stone palace tower with FIVE normal human-height storeys, tiered arched galleries and a high masonry/clay-tile Byzantine dome, flanked by dense THREE-storey stone town wings and rooflines rising toward center. Its central roof silhouette should be clearly taller than Image 1, approx1.6times height above base; the same normal-size door/window units repeat on added floors. Compact mature stone town fills the plot, retain a short narrow front plaza/path for entry and realistic roof spacing; avoid giant enlarged windows or doors, avoid fantasy skyscraper/castle battlements. Keep EXACT SAME square provisional 5x5 TILE BASE footprint and low stone edge border as Image 1; no steps, wings or buildings protrude outside it. The increase is upward, not a bigger base. Rich warm neutral ivory-beige-gray limestone blocks, cream-gray plaster, natural brown wood, muted terracotta fired-clay roof tiles, dark purple cloth banners with gold THREAD embroidery. All dome roof is clay tile over masonry. NO metal roofs, NO copper/gold dome, NO metallic cladding, statues, gilded architectural finials or metal ornaments. Purple/gold identity through fabric only. Natural restrained warm material light, detailed crisp masonry, neutral shadows, not pure white or overly yellow. Composition: horizontal THREE equally sized square panels 3:1, SAME evolved asset in all: left elevated FRONT three-quarter showing entrance, middle strictly TRUE 90-degree RIGHT SIDE elevation (show side window rows, entry portico out of view, not another front), right elevated REAR three-quarter. Keep same camera/world scale as Image 1 ground border; allow higher building into top margin while full plot remains visible; consistent main tower/wings between views. Neutral gray-beige backdrop, no labels, no people, no text or watermark. Request native approx3072x1024 or higher.
